ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Defender Real-Time Protection Failure/Restart
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects issues with Windows Defender Real-Time Protection features Note: Unmapped fields: Feature_Name, Reason

sequences.query: (event_id = 3002 OR event_id = 3007) AND  NOT ((Feature_Name = "\%\%886" AND (Reason = "\%\%892" OR Reason = "\%\%858")))
